subtitle: What 248 parameters, one periodic refit, and a safer candidate actually tell us.

checkpoint_example.interpretation: TERMINAL wins this synthetic example in both arms. No universal END_MAIN selection rule or real-data optimizer superiority follows.
checkpoint_example.selection_rule: strict binary64 <; exact == keeps earliest sequence

reload.weighted_EF_definition: max absolute difference in [energy/3, force × 0.1]; not force RMSE

scope.public_reproduction: Published aggregates support table arithmetic. Native T1 reproduction needs separately provided private licensed source and inputs.

statuses.visible_limit: Engineered and checked on synthetic runs. Not yet demonstrated to be a better real-data optimizer.

COV.D0_origin: NEW PROPOSED metric from pre-radial physical A0 column norms with math.fsum; not native captured D0
COV.acceptance_scope: The saved-row candidate here was not exported as a potential or tested by native J/E/F/gradient. A future runtime transaction must separately evaluate the original native objective and accept or fully restore state under its fixed numerical tolerance.
COV.checkpoint_scope: Checkpoint selection uses completed, genuinely evaluated eligible states and the same objective policy for candidate and control. A model reload is not a full BFGS resume.
COV.covariance_scope: For one already chosen D0, transporting M = T D0 T^T preserves its quadratic increment penalty. Rebuilding a diagonal D0 in an arbitrary starting gauge does not make the whole policy gauge invariant.
COV.feasible_space: delta=T_g z; T_g32x30 with offsets(3,4,2)/sqrt(29) and I29
COV.objective: min_z ||r+A1 T_g z||^2 + ||sqrt(D0) T^T T_g z||^2
COV.physical_accuracy_conclusion: No evidence here of a better real-data optimizer, better external forces or MD suitability.
COV.projected_stationarity: Tg^T [A^T r + (A^T A+M) delta] = 0; delta = Tg z
COV.theorem: For fixed A, r and positive M on V, choose delta in V = image(Tg) minimizing ||r+A delta||² + delta^T M delta. Because zero is feasible and the penalty is nonnegative, the exact minimizer cannot increase data loss.

architecture.auxiliary_state: Scaling, linear multipliers, cutoff settings, caches, inverse Hessian and line-search state are not additional independent coordinates of the same 248-vector.
architecture.geometry_scope: Isolated nonlinear nine-atom geometry in a regular local region, after three translations and three rotations. Special geometries require separate treatment.

objective.external_metric: Force RMSE in eV/Å is evaluated separately, with its own per-geometry and region aggregation.
objective.radial_penalty_formula: P = Σ_k (S_kk−1)² + Σ_(k<l) S_kl²; S = Theta Theta^T
objective.scope: Frozen Train60, nine atoms, energy weight 1, force weight 0.01, stress weight 0, vibrations, no relative-force normalization. The radial penalty is not divided by 60 a second time; cross-channel terms appear once.
objective.unit: weighted objective under the stated training convention; not force RMSE

parameter_blocks.factorization: 3 species × 3 directed neighbor species × 3 channels × 8 radial functions
parameter_blocks.label: Radial coefficients

parameter_blocks.definition: Effective coefficients include the stored linear multipliers.
parameter_blocks.label: Invariant coefficients

parameter_blocks.definition: One offset per species; only one composition-weighted combination is observed on C3H4O2.
parameter_blocks.label: Species offsets

architecture.quotient_scope: Local quotient by the identified symmetries at radial rank 3 and fixed composition. The physical E/F Jacobian rank is at most 240 here; exact rank 240 and completeness of the symmetry group are not established.

linear_system.fixed_D_origin: reconstructed from captured Gc using exact reviewed binary64 source operations; not separately captured
linear_system.native_solver: Gaussian elimination without pivoting, followed by back substitution
linear_system.scope: Each gap is defined in one fixed system and divided by 60. Row-Q minus captured-Q is a difference between problems, not a solve gap or native J. High-precision agreement is numerical resolution, not an interval proof.

systems.definition: Exact dyadic scalar products of the recorded binary64 A and y, plus the reconstructed fixed native D.
Recorded native Gc and bc, with D added in high precision.
The actual recorded binary64 K after the native rounded diagonal addition, with recorded bc.

prediction_prox.basis_covariance: Exact column-space statement; numerical rank selection remains a caveat.
prediction_prox.feasible_space: delta=T_g z, T_g32x30, fixed-composition offset direction plus29 invariant coefficients
prediction_prox.scope: At lambda 1, 75% refers to the available projected least-squares gap; the reduction of the whole incumbent data loss is about 1.338%. Large coefficient increments and numerical rank selection remain limitations.

proof_scope.exact: Finite graph identities and conditional fixed-space inequalities are mathematical results; numeric recovery verifies one authenticated training case.
proof_scope.new_physical_call_scope: This contribution makes no new scientific calls. Six recovered physical replay results are consumed as saved inputs. The separate session ledger records the full recovery cost.
not_proved: Complete classification of all channel symmetries
Global convergence of the hybrid optimizer
Lower external force error from lower training J
A faster or better real-data COV optimizer
proof_scope.publication_boundary: Only the named aggregate scalars, small state tables, source-relative identifiers, SHA-256 values and explanatory formulas are allowlisted here. No source code, fitted coefficients, checkpoints, full matrices, replay arrays or event journals are exported.

transport.conditions: The specific finite L12 graph; an invertible lower-triangular channel map common to the channels; force equality on a smooth geometry region.
transport.orientation: Phi1=T Phi0, A1=A0 T^T, beta1c=T^{-T} beta0

physical_EF.scope: Transport on the authenticated Train60 configurations only.

transport.scope: Exact algebra proves functional transport under its assumptions. The new numerical parity check covers the authenticated Train60 points; it does not prove unseen prediction accuracy or full-J gauge invariance.
